title: Dad's New Phone
intro: A message says it is your dad, on a new phone. After today you are suspicious, but real people change numbers too.
But some messages are real. Mirage loves it when you stop trusting the honest ones.

notify.text: Hi it is Dad, I got a new phone

screen.context: Your dad told you last week at dinner that he was getting a new phone.

msg.text: I got the new phone, this is my number now.
Call me when you are free, I would like to hear how your exam went.
No rush, nothing needed. Just save the number.

num.label: A new number
num.lens: A number you do not have saved yet.
num.why: A new number can be real, so check it calmly.

newphone.label: It fits what he told you
newphone.lens: He told you last week he would get a new phone.
newphone.why: It matches something you already knew. That is a strong honest sign.

call.label: Asks you to call
call.lens: He wants to talk and hear about your exam.
call.why: A real family member wants to talk, not hide.

nomoney.label: Asks for nothing
nomoney.lens: No money, no codes, no rush.
nomoney.why: A message that asks for nothing is usually honest.

actions.label: Call the new number, and also call his old number, before saving it

go_ahead.line: You called the old number, which was off, then the new one. It was Dad, with the new phone. You saved the number.

ignore.line: Nothing bad happened. A call would have confirmed it and let you save the number.

block_report.line: That was really Dad. Checking, not reporting, is the skill: a call settles it.
block_report.mirageSays: If you trust nothing, I win anyway.

what_if.block_report: It matched something he told you, asked for nothing, and invited a call. A quick call confirms it.
what_if.ignore: Ignoring was safe. Recognising a real message is the skill: it asks for nothing secret and matches something you know.

golden_rule: A new number that asks for nothing and matches something you know is likely honest. Confirm with a call before saving it.

quick_check.q: What made this "new number" message likely honest?

options.text: It matched what he had told you and asked for no money
It was sent in the evening

quick_check.explain: It fit what you knew and asked for nothing. A call confirms it.

hints.nudge: What is this message actually asking you to do?

rows.k: Did he tell you about a new phone?
A relative from a new number
rows.v: Check by calling a number you know
